title: Choose a new name: Stacks is unavailable on the App Store
acceptance: A name chosen and confirmed available in App Store Connect, not merely absent from App Store search
The rename lands before TestFlight, while the CloudKit container still holds only the owner's data
Bundle identifiers, app group, CloudKit container, product name, scheme, directory names and the repo are all updated together
notes: DECIDED 2026-08-25: the app is CAIRN. Checked against the iTunes search API — no published app holds the exact name; the owner must still confirm the reservation in App Store Connect, which is stricter. Chosen because a cairn is literally a stack of stones, keeping continuity with the original name, and its purpose is to mark a path so you can find your way back — which is the product thesis. SCOPE DECIDED TOO: rename everything user-visible plus the three bundle identifiers, but KEEP group.com.calvinbrown.Stacks and iCloud.com.calvinbrown.Stacks. Reason: the SwiftData store lives in the app group container (StacksApp.swift:60 -> AppGroup.storeURL), so a bundle-id change alone preserves every post, tag, highlight and note, while changing the group id orphans the entire library. Highlights and notes are the one thing that cannot be re-fetched. Container identifiers are invisible plumbing and Tools/configure.sh rewrites them for contributors.

history.detail: Cairn; user-visible rename only, container identifiers preserved to protect the library
